words.example: The May training schedule is posted in the staff room.
words.exampleZh: 五月的培训日程贴在员工休息室里。

words.example: Calling patients forward is a basic competency at this counter.
words.exampleZh: 把患者叫到柜台前，是这个岗位的一项基本能力要求。

words.example: The skill matrix shows who can run the night registration desk.
words.exampleZh: 技能矩阵上能看出谁可以值夜班挂号台。

words.example: Her job grade changes only if this promotion is approved.
words.exampleZh: 只有这次晋升获批，她的职级才会变动。

words.example: That post sits in pay band four on the hospital pay scale.
words.exampleZh: 这个岗位在医院薪级表上属于第四级。

words.example: A DoD wipe takes longer, so reserve it for drives that stored patient identifiers.
words.exampleZh: 国防部擦除更花时间，留给存过患者标识的硬盘。

words.example: Keep a spare disk of the same size on the shelf beside the imaging array.
words.exampleZh: 在影像阵列旁边的架子上留一块同样大小的备用磁盘。

words.example: The hot spare took over within a minute after disk three dropped out of the set.
words.exampleZh: 三号盘掉出阵列后，热备盘在一分钟内接上了。

words.example: The cold spare is on the shelf, so someone has to seat it before the rebuild starts.
words.exampleZh: 冷备盘在架子上，得有人把它装进去，重建才会开始。

words.example: Rebuild time on this wide set is about a day, so leave the hot spare assigned.
words.exampleZh: 这么宽的一组盘，重建时间大约一天，热备盘先别拆。
